verdict: Fully authentic Baklava usage with zero API hallucinations: every tag (bl-table, bl-table-header sticky, bl-table-body, bl-table-row, bl-table-cell, bl-badge size=small, bl-button variant=secondary size=small label, bl-pagination) and every attribute/event verified real via the MCP server, including the real bl-change event with its selectedPage detail for the pagination. Implements the requested grid with column headers, per-row action button, bottom pagination controls, and a 'Popular' badge on one row; badge CSS uses the real --bl-badge-bg-color/--bl-badge-color custom properties. Only minor nit: the per-row action buttons are presentational placeholders with no click handler wired.
